newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet steady to lower, Gulf firms on buying.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet steady to lower, Gulf firms on buying.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were steady to moderately lower Friday tracking weaker March NYMEX values and mixed differentials, players said.
U.S. Gulf Coast aviation-quality 54-grade saw diffs firm a half cent a gallon on prompt front-fourth-cycle material to offers of 1.60 cents above the March print, traders said.
"A couple of majors came in buying and pushed things up. It's a thin Friday market," giving diffs an easier boost, one Gulf broker said.
New York 54-grade diffs, by contrast, eased about 0.25 cent to 5.75 cents over the March print, traders said.
